blocks.text: Wood Rot Repair and/or Replacement

We repair and/or replace rotted wood on exteriors and interiors, including trim/fascia, beams, and framing, using quality materials to restore structural integrity and prepare surfaces for flawless painting.
Siding Repair and/or Replacement

We remove and replace rotted/damaged siding (wood, vinyl, or aluminum), addressing cracks, warping, or weather damaged with high-quality, weather-resistant materials to ensure long-lasting protection and curb appeal.
Door & Window Frame Repairs
We fix warped, rotted, or damaged door and window frames, using eco-friendly materials and custom solutions to improve functionality and complement your property’s design.
